continuity_scope: The Apothecary Diaries, J-Novel Club authorized English light-novel Volume 1, bounded to the publisher's Volume 1 synopsis and its official Part 1 reader locator. The source pass excludes the remainder of Volume 1 beyond the synopsis-level claims, later novels, manga versions, anime, and all adaptations.

work_or_witnesses.edition: J-Novel Club authorized English light-novel edition

coverage_rule: Include named individual dramatic characters directly named and described in J-Novel Club's Volume 1 synopsis: Maomao and Jinshi. The page names the Emperor and a favorite consort only by offices, so neither becomes a character record. The official Part 1 reader URL bounds the opening segment but exposes no accessible text in this pass; no page-level facts are inferred from it.
omissions: All other Volume 1 people, including the Emperor, favorite consort, and apothecary father, because the selected synopsis supplies office or family descriptions but no individual name.
Court ranks, palace institutions, medicine/apothecary practice, poisons, illnesses, places, artifacts, and social structures as character nodes.
Novel material beyond the source synopsis, later volumes, manga, anime, and adaptations.
content_cautions: The selected synopsis says Maomao was kidnapped and sold into service, and that she is made to taste food for poison. It does not give a scene-level account of coercion, violence, illness, injury, death, or bodily harm; this pass makes no further claim.
Medicine and poison claims are source-fiction and synopsis-level only; they are not real medical, toxicological, diagnostic, or treatment advice.

Court, gender, service, and eunuch terms are recorded as the publisher's fictional setting labels. They do not establish anatomy, gender identity, legal status, or equivalence to a specific real court or culture.
uncertainties: J-Novel Club's Volume 1 page credits Natsu Hyuuga, Touko Shino, Kevin Steinbach, and Sasha McGlynn but the selected official English pages do not display Japanese-script character names; no Japanese names, readings, or alternate English forms are inferred.
The accessible Part 1 reader is a primary locator but does not expose readable chapter text through the available interface. Character claims remain official-synopsis level.
The selected metadata does not establish exact medical diagnoses, poison mechanisms, palace hierarchy, Jinshi's biography or bodily status, Maomao's age, or later relationships.
Manga and anime are separate continuities and unreviewed.
evidence_basis: J-Novel Club's official series and Volume 1 listing supplies the licensed-English edition, creator/translator/editor credits, synopsis-level characters, court framing, medicine knowledge, and poison-tasting assignment. The official Part 1 reader URL supplies the primary opening-segment locator only. No fan wiki or Wikipedia was used.

supports: Authorized English light-novel context; Natsu Hyuuga/Touko Shino/Kevin Steinbach/Sasha McGlynn credits; Maomao and Jinshi synopsis claims; rear-palace, medicine, poison, and court framing.
